description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the SegmentHDBody operation in the image segmentation (imageseg) category
description_zh: 本文介绍分割抠图（imageseg）类目下的高清人体分割SegmentHDBody的语法及示例
name: SegmentHDBody

parameters.help_en:
The image URL. Use OSS URLs in the China (Shanghai) region. If your file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Image format requirements:
Image formats: JPG, JPEG, BMP, and PNG (transparent images).
Image size: Up to 40 MB.
Image resolution: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 6,000 × 6,000 pixels. The longest side must be less than or equal to 6,000 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
图片格式要求：
图像格式：JPG、JPEG 、BMP、PNG（透明图）。
图像大小：不超过40 MB 。
图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于6000×6000像素，最长边小于等于6000像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: image_url

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the result image.
The output image is generated by adding an alpha channel to the three channels of the original image, resulting in a four-channel PNG image. The image is uncompressed, and the dimensions remain unchanged, but the file size increases.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
结果图像URL地址。
输出图像在原始图像的3通道基础上增加alpha通道生成四通道PNG图像作为输出，无压缩，图像尺寸保持不变，图像体积会变大。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
